_doc: Golden cases that neither the validator-only runner nor the end-to-end runner (labs/memory-claims-lab/run_claims.py: idle pass -> validator -> guarded writer on a scratch store, scripted model) gets right yet, with what differs, grouped by cause. A RATCHET: an entry may only be removed (delete it when the case goes green), never added without a reason in review. tests/test_memory_claims_validate.py fails when a listed case starts passing (remove it) and when the list grows past its ceiling. 2026-11-14: 77 -> 10 when redesign steps 6-7 (the guarded writer and the idle attribute read) landed; the 67 removed cases pass end to end.

reasons.attrs: needs the guarded writer and the idle attribute read: redesign steps 6-7 (kept for the ratchet test; no case is listed under it any more)
reasons.edges: needs the guarded writer and the idle attribute read: redesign steps 6-7 (kept for the ratchet test; no case is listed under it any more: a relation subject resolves through the people row's relationship word)
reasons.end_to_end: needs the guarded writer and the idle attribute read: redesign steps 6-7 (kept for the ratchet test; no case is listed under it any more)
reasons.label: a THING is matched by exact label only (design note K, an accepted limit of v1): the stored row and the correction name it differently, so the claim abstains on rule 9 and the row keeps the old value
reasons.decision: golden vs code disagreement that needs an owner or golden-set decision; see the case entry
reasons.schema: the expected rule cannot be observed: the oracle abstains, so no claim reaches the validator. The outcome (left as mined) agrees

K08.detail: two people share the name: the validator HOLDS the animal candidate pending (rule D.14 + owner question J.2); the golden expects refuse because every reading is a person. Pick one and change the other.

K13.detail: the decision (add) is right; the golden expects it reported under rule 4, rule_14_kind reports a hyphen-part mismatch under rule 14. A labelling choice.

C44.detail: an unresolved nickname becomes the label form (design note B.3), so the claim abstains on rule 9 (no row carries that label); the golden expects rule 3. Proposal: change the golden expectation to 9 - rule 3 is the prefix-tier refusal and no prefix match exists with allow_prefix=False. Outcome (left as mined) agrees.

C05.detail: row: 'a dentist appointment'; correction: 'the dentist'. Passes on today's regex path.

C06.detail: row: 'car rego'; correction: 'the rego'. Passes on today's regex path.

C37.detail: row: User's dad (the relation, label rel:father with no father in the graph); correction subject 'dad' without 'my' is read as a name, label 'dad'. Fails today too.

E14.detail: the event is filed and listed under health, but as user_stated (the correction writer class) where the golden expects user_stated_derived. MemoryService.ingest has no way for a caller to resolve authority on the member's quote while storing code-authored text; needs a small ingest change before emergency filing is turned on.
